description:
Activate Skyshroud Ranger by tapping it, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Skyshroud Ranger.
Repeat.
